verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a single-command Arch/Hyprland installer that sets up a full desktop with dev tools (OpenCode, Claude Code, Lazygit, VSCode/Cursor/Zed/Helix integration) and provides an Install > Development menu to add runtimes/environments post-install, and community reports confirm the install-and-go experience ('Installing software is easy and lightning-fast', 'the install is uncomplicated').
